findings.text: The condition calls `Error(t, panicErr)` and `EqualError(t, panicErr, errString)`, and both report a failure on `t` themselves. A panic with `errors.New("other")` checked against "crazy error" therefore logs the EqualError failure and then a second Fail from the line below it. Use non-reporting comparisons instead, such as `panicErr.Error() == errString` after the `ok` check.
